config.design: Restart H280 KL adapter, same64 reads and normalizers. Loss intactKL+.1 correctionEnergy/baseStateErrorEnergy+lambda*baseTrainingKL*responseMSE/baseResponseErrorEnergy. Exact response quadratic statistics over actual/angle full removals, fit heads0:6. First768 train,next256 validation. All8 runs retained. Select min validation intactKL among checkpoints with <=2% loss vs H280 and responseMSE<=base separately for actual/angle fit heads. If none, select minimum intactKL/H280KL+max response ratio and label fallback. Heldout heads6:9 never select.

gates.state_retention: fresh selected intactKL vs H280 relative worsening<=2%, paired95 upper<=.02
gates.response_gain: fresh actual and angle fit-head responseMSE reduce>=5% vs H280,paired95 lower>0
gates.base_response_retention: fresh responseMSE vs base worsening<=2% upper95 for actual and angle
gates.heldout_transfer: same response gain vs H280 on heads6:9

config.scope: Response regularizer uses output MSE, not downstream KL. Also report conditional response KL. Training-head exclusion applies only to this added response loss; base learned from all heads earlier. Not wholly unseen heads. No global optimum assertion.
